## Information
Light up the festive season with the 425 LED Christmas Tree, designed to bring a magical glow to your celebrations. Featuring a white illumination and a striking arrangement of 425 bright LEDs, this artificial tree effortlessly creates a cosy ambience. Enjoy easy setup with a generous cable length, making it ideal for living rooms or hallways. Add a sparkling centrepiece to your festivities and enjoy endless seasonal cheer.
